Workstream 1 — National capacity/cost/architecture audit complete. Corrected finding: Supabase org plan is Pro (8,192MB included storage, not the previously-assumed 4,500MB) — kept 4,500MB as the working internal safety margin anyway. All 5 public comparison-API interfaces measured live via EXPLAIN ANALYZE: 4-101ms, all well under target. One optimisation candidate found (no index on ILIKE suburb-name search) and documented for Workstream 17, not fixed yet.

Workstream 2 — National source discovery for QLD/SA/WA/TAS/ACT/NT complete (live-verified via WebSearch + gstack /browse + CKAN API/curl, not search-snippet-only). Key finding: free bulk automatable SALES data does not exist in any of the 6 states — all paid or blocked. RENT is available free for QLD (RTA, verified, current to Jun 2026), SA (SA Housing Trust, verified via CKAN API, history to 2008), and WA (DMIRS raw bond lodgements, CC BY 4.0, needs in-house median computation — flagged as extra adapter work). TAS got search-only verification (flagged for follow-up). ACT and NT both live-searched directly against their official portals and confirmed zero results — national-context-only for both this sprint.

Workstream 3 — jurisdiction_coverage.yml + JURISDICTION_COVERAGE_CONTRACT.md complete, built directly from Workstream 2's findings. Documents per-jurisdiction x per-metric-family status for all 8 states/territories. Key finding: supply/demographic context already available nationally for all 8 (confirmed, not assumed); land_values/vacancy/planning_pipeline unavailable nationally (no source found for ANY jurisdiction including NSW/VIC, an honest gap); population_growth capped at partially_available everywhere pending Workstream 4.

Workstream 4 — Cross-Census 2016-2021 population harmonisation COMPLETE. Downloaded live-verified ABS correspondence files (SA1/SA2/LGA/POA/SAL) and 2016 Census G01 population (SSC/POA grain). Built population-weighted conversion reconciling to 100.00% of Australia's true 2016 population for both SAL and POA. Loaded to branch as a pure UPDATE (no schema change, zero storage growth): 15,333/15,334 SAL and 2,641/2,641 POA rows now have population_2016; 10,935 SAL and 2,596 POA have a publishable growth rate. Independently re-verified post-commit.

Workstream 5 — National population-demand layer COMPLETE. Downloaded ABS Regional Population Table 1 (genuine observed ERP, SA2 grain, 2001-2025, no bot protection). Built local store: 61,335 (SA2 x year) observations across 2,454 SA2 geographies, with 1-year and 5-year-annualised growth. Validated: national total 27,613,654 at June 2025 matches Australia's known population; independently-computed top-5 fastest-growing SA2s matched ABS's own published narrative highlights verbatim. Deliberately NOT promoted to branch — SA2 has no mart table yet, deferred to Workstream 9.
